reason: Most of my collabs are barter, so a fair-rate check, payment reminders and a 5% cut don't do much for me yet. What I want is more followers and reach, and the only growth bit here, auto-DM to commenters, is locked behind Pro. I might try the free version once, but I wouldn't pay for it.
objection: Influish costs the same and already has lakhs of creators sending them leads. My WhatsApp groups already give me collab leads, and Mitra is a small beta team that only helps me manage deals I already have.
would_change_my_mind: If it actually brought me collab leads or helped me grow followers, for example by matching me with Bengaluru brands, instead of only managing deals I find myself.
